<script>
const SURV = 6;
const N = 20;
tl.fromTo("#cam", { scale: 1.04 }, { scale: 1.1, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#pool", { scale: .9, opacity: .7 }, { scale: 1.05, opacity: 1, duration: 1.4, ease: "power2.out" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#fg", { y: 260 }, { y: -40, duration: DURATION, ease: "power2.out" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#fg2", { x: 160 }, { x: 0, duration: 1.2, ease: "expo.out" }, 0);
tl.fromTo(".sat", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: .55, duration: .8, stagger: .1, ease: "power2.out" }, .1);
tl.fromTo("#far", { y: 30 }, { y: -30, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#front", { y: 120, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: .7, ease: "expo.out" }, .05);

// The wall of ideas: twenty of them, arriving from scattered depths.
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
  tl.fromTo("#c" + i,
    { opacity: 0, y: 140 + rand(i) * 160, x: (rand(i + 40) - .5) * 120, scale: .7, rotation: (rand(i + 80) - .5) * 20 },
    { opacity: 1, y: 0, x: 0, scale: 1, rotation: (rand(i + 120) - .5) * 6, duration: .7, ease: "expo.out" },
    .15 + i * .035);
}

// Nineteen of them never make it: one at a time they drop into the drawer.
const never = at("never", 1.6);
let k = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
  if (i === SURV) continue;
  const t = never + k * .075;
  const el = document.getElementById("c" + i);
  const dx = 455 - parseFloat(el.style.left);
  const dy = 905 - parseFloat(el.style.top);
  tl.to("#c" + i, { x: dx, y: dy, scale: .55, rotation: (rand(i + 200) - .5) * 40, duration: .42, ease: "power3.in" }, t);
  tl.to("#c" + i, { opacity: 0, duration: .08, ease: "none" }, t + .4);
  tl.fromTo("#front", { y: 0 }, { y: 4, duration: .05, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power1.out" }, t + .42);
  k++;
}

// The survivor stays lit and moves to the middle of the frame.
tl.to("#c" + SURV, { x: 540 - 85 - 565, y: 520 - 58 - 336, scale: 1.7, rotation: 0, duration: .9, ease: "expo.out" }, never + .5);
tl.to("#c" + SURV, { borderColor: "#C323DC", boxShadow: "0 0 70px rgba(195,35,220,.75), 0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55)", duration: .5, ease: "power2.out" }, never + .7);

// "…in the drafts folder": the drawer slams, its light dies, the room dims.
const shut = at("drafts", 3.3);
tl.to("#front", { y: -38, scaleY: .96, transformOrigin: "50% 0%", duration: .16, ease: "power4.in" }, shut);
tl.to("#cam", { y: 10, duration: .05, yoyo: true, repeat: 3, ease: "none" }, shut + .16);
tl.to("#lock", { fill: "#2a1238", duration: .25, ease: "power2.out" }, shut + .18);
tl.to("#lockHalo", { opacity: 0, scale: .4, svgOrigin: "540 962", duration: .3, ease: "power2.out" }, shut + .18);
tl.to("#pool", { opacity: .45, scale: .85, duration: .8, ease: "power2.out" }, shut + .15);
tl.fromTo("#strip", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: .5, ease: "expo.out" }, shut + .3);
</script>
